verbs.name: open

takes.name: path
takes.refusal: a path must be a non-empty string, not {given}

doc: Open the binary at {path} for this session and analyze it; every other verb acts on the binary
opened last. The options arch, bits, base, map and format force how a raw or headerless file is

verbs.name: cmd

takes.name: command
takes.refusal: a rizin command is a string, not {given}

doc: Run one read-only rizin {command} on the open binary, at {addr} when given: the one way to read it.
An empty command answers the engine's manual.

verbs.name: json

takes.name: command
takes.refusal: a rizin command is a string, not {given}

doc: Run one read-only rizin {command} whose output is JSON, a *j command, and answer the data itself
with the id of the evidence record the read left. Reads the whole output even when it is past the
size cap a result's text is cut at.

verbs.name: call

takes.name: tool
takes.refusal: a tool is named by a string, as {listTools} lists them, not {given}

doc: Call the engine's {tool}, a name the verb tools lists, with its arguments.

verbs.name: tools
doc: Every tool the engine offers, one line each.

verbs.name: doc
doc: What the engine's {tool} does and the arguments it takes.

verbs.name: slash
doc: Run one of the lines the engine's text calls /re lines ("functions", "evidence", "findings",
"verify", "report out.md", "undo", "help") and answer what it says.

verbs.name: status
doc: The engine's state for this session: rizin, the open binary, evidence and findings.

verbs.name: help
doc: The engine's manual: which rizin commands read what, the tools, the lines, how a result reads.
